metrics.note: Real size ASSUMED: the patent has no scale and only one view, so depth and hidden parts are inferred (see the unknowns below). Nothing here is measured from a second view.

unknowns: CRITICAL: Depth (Z width) of base_bed, headstock_block, cylinder_block, crank_housing and all panels — would resolve: Plan view and both end views, or a stated overall width dimension / photo of the real machine
CRITICAL: Exact overall length, height and all absolute dimensions / scale — would resolve: A dimensioned general-arrangement drawing or patent specification text with dimensions

CRITICAL: Drive train between drive_motor_shaft (7) and crankshaft (55) / crank_gear_flywheel — would resolve: Patent specification text, a section on a perpendicular plane, or an end view with cover removed
CRITICAL: Blade drive mechanism above cutting_blade (65/65x/85) — would resolve: Uncropped top of the sheet or a second view/section through the blade ram
Crank radius, crankshaft journal offset, connecting_rod length and piston stroke — would resolve: Dimension for stroke, or side/end views of crank at two positions
Internal passages labels 69,70,73 and function of work_chamber 27 (fluid, air, or workpiece) — would resolve: Patent specification description of operation, or a plan section showing ports
True function and identity of the machine (cutter, press, pump or engine) and of parts 1,26,27,29 — would resolve: Patent number / title page and specification text
Feed mechanism kinematics: feed_rod 8 drive, lever 42/43 pivot support bracket, and link 44/45 anchor points — would resolve: End view from the left, or an external (non-sectional) side elevation
Spring rate, blade thickness/material grade, bearing types, seal materials, motor power/speed — would resolve: Patent specification, parts list or materials schedule
Fastener sizes, counts and positions beyond those visible (15,22,58,67) — would resolve: Front external elevation (looking along -Z) and end views
